g.text: 2015 El Niño: Seasonal RO and Standard PMM
February–June monthly-state initializations; leads 1–9 months (45 pairs). PMM = canonical MCA SST index.
Path arrows indicate time; every colored trajectory is freely integrated after initialization, including PMM.
WWV proxy: GODAS mean D20. Shared phase scales: σT = 0.870 °C; σh = 7.174 m. Lead 0 is shown but not scored.
Figure design follows manuscript Fig. 3; the forecasts are for the observed 2015 event, not a synthetic simulation.
